Class Iso639Table

java.lang.Object
com.hitorro.util.language.Iso639TableBase
com.hitorro.language.Iso639Table
public class Iso639Table extends com.hitorro.util.language.Iso639TableBase
Table of languages. The languages have rich methods for constructing NLP models used by such things as PartOfSpeachSingleton and SentenceDetectorSingleton.
